signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.withProvider: Or sign in with an external service:
signIn.noAccount: You do not have an account?
signIn.emailCheckResent: If the address has an account, we sent a new email to it.

register.title: Make an account
register.checkYourEmail: We sent an email to {{email}}. Open the link in the email to complete your account.

checkEmail.title: Email address check
checkEmail.checking: The application checks your email address.
checkEmail.done: We checked your email address. You can sign in now.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.instructions: Type the email address of your account. We send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.done: If {{email}} has an account, we sent a link to it. The link is valid for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.done: We saved your new password and stopped all your sessions. Sign in with the new password.
